title: Kenworth T909/T900 FUPS Double Channel Road Train high tensile Aluminium Bullbar #60
description: Kenworth T909/T900 FUPS Double Channel Road Train high tensile aluminium Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia pipe available. Plate over tow hitch (can be painted to suit chassis). Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Full length 100mm wide box uprights for maximum protection. Stick-on Road Train signs with silver covers, cowcatcher and 3 small uprights plus sump guard. Heavy duty mesh to centre section to protect radiator. Additional light bar mounted to bonnet. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
